title: The Sweep
eyebrow: Every ticket already on the board brought up to the bar the pour now enforces

actions.fyi: Nothing waiting on you. This is the one you asked for first; the two pieces it needed are finished and on the main line. This page fills in as the sweep runs.

content.label: What is wrong today
content.lead: The bar is now enforced on every new ticket. The tickets already standing were written before it existed.

blocks.label: Why this is more than the eighty-eight you were told
blocks.text: Eighty-eight was counted this morning by reading, before the bar was a machine anyone could run. Run as a machine over every ticket still standing, it is 221. The jump is almost all one line: the sentence about what a job leaves out was printed identically onto 173 tickets, and a printed sentence tells you nothing.

content.label: In and working
content.lead: The measuring tool is on the main line. The board can now be held to the bar in one run, any day.

rows: The whole board, run through the bars
221 of 347 named, one line each, and the run comes back unhappy while any remain.
The board's own test run
Nineteen checks green, none red. Two of them new.
A bar the sweep would not measure
Caught by name — the ticket-writing side and the measuring side are held to one list.
Tickets touched while measuring
None. It reads the board and writes nothing.
Rewrites held to the bar as they are written
Six of my own were turned away for naming nothing checkable, before they could land.
What a job leaves out
All 173 rewritten, none of them printed. That line is now clear across the whole board.
The finish line
All 113 rewritten to name something anyone can run and what it must produce. Clear across the board.
The bar corrected twice by the sweep
Ten honest finish lines named a real command the bar did not know, and several stated an outcome a run settles rather than a number. Both widened, and the test run is green after.
The words a title is written in
All 77 rewritten. Nothing on the board is now titled in the words of whoever built it.
Where a thing filed in passing is
All 13 rewritten. Five named a picture the app can draw rather than a file, so the bar learned that a picture is a place too.
The whole board, measured again
Nothing cleared by deleting it
All 330 tickets read back off the board: no section gone, none written twice, none left empty.
The board's own test run
Twenty checks green, none red.

content.label: How the rest runs
content.lead: A tool measures, a person rewrites, and the same tool says when it is finished.

items: A tool reads the whole board and names every ticket below the bar, and which part of it falls short. It stays afterwards as the board's health check — you can run it any day.
Every rewrite is written onto the card through one gate that holds it to the same bar a new ticket answers to, so the sweep cannot finish by writing 221 fresh sentences that mean nothing.
Then four passes, one per kind of failure, each written from what the ticket already says — never invented, and never cleared by deleting the section.
The tool run at the end is what says the sweep is done.

decisions.title: Finished tickets are left alone
decisions.why: You read the open board, not the archive. Rewriting closed history would be churn nobody sees, and would bury the sweep under three times the work.

decisions.title: Where a ticket never said how it would be judged, I decide it
decisions.why: Most of the weak ones are weak because nobody wrote a finish line at all. Coming to you 221 times is not a sweep.

decisions.title: No section is ever dropped to clear the bar
decisions.why: A ticket clears the bar by saying more, not by saying less. A sweep allowed to delete would report itself finished while leaving the board emptier than it found it.
